title: Station Table Data
description: Schema for the station table used in daily reports. Each key is a station group name, and the value is an array of unit rows.

StationRow.description: A single generating-unit row inside a station group.

stationNumber.description: Unit number within the station group.

peakCapacity.description: Available capacity at peak hour in MW.

minReserveCapacity.description: Available capacity at minimum reserve hour in MW.

secondaryFuelPeakCapacity.description: Available capacity at peak hour using secondary fuel in MW.

startTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the unit started. Optional — omitted if the unit is not running.

endTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the unit is expected to stop.

updatedEndTime.description: ISO-8601 updated end time if the original end time changed.
